description: Raises the monthly BPJS Ketenagakerjaan remittance task when a payslip owes JHT, JKK, JKM or JP.
name: BPJS Ketenagakerjaan contributions (JHT, JKK, JKM, JP)

references.title: PP 44/2015 arts.21–22(1) (https://www.bpjsketenagakerjaan.go.id/assets/uploads/peraturan/15122015_104557_PP%2044%20Tahun%202015.pdf); PP 45/2015 arts.30–31 (https://www.bpjsketenagakerjaan.go.id/assets/uploads/peraturan/15122015_104556_PP%2045%20Tahun%202015.pdf); PP 46/2015 (JHT billed with them)

description: Raises the monthly BPJS Kesehatan remittance task when a payslip owes a health contribution.
name: BPJS Kesehatan contribution

references.title: Perpres 82/2018 arts.39(1), 42 as amended by Perpres 64/2020 and 59/2024

description: Raises the monthly PPh 21/26 deposit task when a payslip withholds income tax.
name: PPh 21/26 deposit

references.title: PMK 81/2024 art.94(2); PMK 105/2025 art.5(1)–(2), PMK 10/2025 art.5(1)–(2) (DTP paid in cash to the worker, not deposited)

description: Raises the DKPTKA compensation-fund payment task when a foreign worker's payslip carries it.
name: DKPTKA foreign-worker compensation fund

references.title: PP 34/2021 arts.1 angka 7, 23, 25; USD 100 per position per month, paid in advance (Kemnaker PNBP tariff, as PP 34/2021 applies it; secondary)

description: Raises the monthly PPh 21/26 return task for every payroll run.
name: SPT Masa PPh 21/26
condition: return true;

description: Raises the annual BPA1 batch reminder for the December tax year; leavers have their own exit task.
name: BPA1 batch for the tax year (leavers have their own exit task)
condition:
const month = String(ctx.entry.salary_coverage.from).slice(0, 7);
return month.endsWith('-12');

description: Raises the January task to confirm each employee's PTKP status for the new tax year.
name: PTKP status as at 1 January
condition:
const month = String(ctx.entry.salary_coverage.from).slice(0, 7);
return month.endsWith('-01');

description: Raises the January task to review the new provincial and city minimum wages against payroll.
name: New provincial and city minimum wages in force

references.title: PP 36/2021 arts.23(3), 25 as amended by PP 51/2023 and PP 49/2025

condition:
const month = String(ctx.entry.salary_coverage.from).slice(0, 7);
return month.endsWith('-01');

description: Raises a wage-slip task for each payslip when the run is paid.
name: Wage slip
condition: return ctx.entry.state === 'PAID';

description: Raises the 30-day BPJS Ketenagakerjaan registration task for a new worker, except a short-stay foreign worker.
name: BPJS Ketenagakerjaan registration of a new worker

description: Raises the BPJS Kesehatan registration task for a new worker, except a short-stay foreign worker.
name: BPJS Kesehatan registration of a new worker

description: Raises the task to record a new employee's PTKP status and tax identity.
name: PTKP status and tax identity of a new employee
condition:
if (ctx.entry.engagement === 'PAYEE') return false;
return ctx.entry.status === 'SEALED';

description: Raises the task to register a fixed-term contract with the ministry within the working-day deadline.
name: PKWT registration with the ministry
condition:
if (ctx.entry.engagement === 'PAYEE') return false;
return ctx.entry.status === 'SEALED' && ctx.entry.signed_contract_period != null;

description: Raises the RPTKA approval and DKPTKA payment task for a foreign worker who is not exempt.
name: RPTKA approval and DKPTKA payment for a foreign worker

description: Raises the leaver's BPA1 task for the month after the employment ends.
name: Bukti potong 1721-A1 (BPA1) for a leaver

description: Raises the JKP termination notice for a covered termination, excluding causes and workers outside JKP.
name: Termination notice to BPJS Ketenagakerjaan (JKP)

references.title: PP 37/2021 art.20 as amended by PP 6/2025

description: Raises the employment-termination report unless the worker resigned or died.
name: Report of a termination of employment

description: Raises the first compulsory employment report (WLKP) within 30 days of the sealed entity version.
name: Compulsory employment report (WLKP) on establishment
condition: return ctx.entry.status === 'SEALED';

description: Raises the annual WLKP task on the anniversary month of the first report.
name: Annual compulsory employment report (WLKP)

references.title: UU 7/1981
references.locator: art.7(1) and Penjelasan Pasal 7; Permenaker 18/2017 as amended by Permenaker 4/2019

description: Raises the stage-I work-accident report to BPJS Ketenagakerjaan within 2 × 24 hours of the first recorded accident day.
name: Work accident report to BPJS Ketenagakerjaan (stage I)
condition:
const catalog = first(ctx.reads.leave_catalog);
return catalog != null && catalog.code === 'WORK_ACCIDENT_LEAVE';

description: Raises the company-regulation renewal task when the ratified rules expire while at least 10 workers are employed.
name: Renewal of the company regulations (Peraturan Perusahaan)
condition: return true;

description: Raises the THR payment task seven days before a religious holiday when the holiday falls in or just after the pay window.
name: THR before the religious holiday
condition: return true;

description: Raises the monthly task to issue PPh 21/26 withholding slips for the run.
name: Monthly PPh 21/26 withholding slips
condition: return true;

description: Raises the 5% THR fine task when a THR entry is dated after the seven-day deadline.
name: Late THR: 5% fine

description: Raises the task to pay fixed-term compensation when the fixed term and the employment both end.
name: PKWT period ended: pay its compensation

description: Raises the companion, training and Indonesian-language task for a foreign worker who is not exempt.
name: Foreign worker: companion, training and Indonesian language

references.title: UU 13/2003 art.45 as amended by UU 6/2023

description: Raises an internal January review of the 1% disability employment quota when the entity has at least the seeded 100 workers; the 100-worker threshold is an internal convention, not statutory text.
name: Disability employment quota review (internal)

description: Raises the task to form a bipartite cooperation body when the entity has at least 50 workers and no formation date.
name: Bipartite cooperation body (LKS Bipartit)
condition: return true;

description: Raises a one-time task to establish SMK3 and form P2K3 when the entity reaches 100 workers or declares high hazard.
name: SMK3 and P2K3 (one-time, threshold met)
condition: return true;

description: Raises an internal January reminder to run the annual health examination programme for workers; the statutory duty is per worker, not an entity filing.
name: Annual worker health examination programme

references.title: Permenakertrans PER.02/MEN/1980, official Kemnaker-hosted text read 2026-10-10: https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/asset/data_puu/1980PermenakertransPER2MEN%20.pdf arts.2, 3(2)

condition:
const month = String(ctx.entry.salary_coverage.from).slice(0, 7);
return month.endsWith('-01');

description: Raises a one-time task to put a wage structure and scale in place and apply it to the entity's workers.
name: Wage structure and scale (one-time)
condition: return true;

description: Raises the task to notify a new worker of the wage scale for their job group.
name: Notify a new worker of their wage scale
condition:
if (ctx.entry.engagement === 'PAYEE') return false;
return ctx.entry.status === 'SEALED';

description: Raises the BPJS Ketenagakerjaan wage-change report when a sealed contract changes the monthly rate.
name: BPJS Ketenagakerjaan wage-change report

description: Raises the BPJS Ketenagakerjaan exit report when a covered worker leaves.
name: BPJS Ketenagakerjaan exit report

description: Raises the BPJS Ketenagakerjaan entity-change report when the employer's name or registered address changes.
name: BPJS Ketenagakerjaan entity-change report

description: Raises the personal-data breach notification task when a breach case is opened.
name: Personal-data breach notification
condition: return ctx.entry.kind === 'PERSONAL_DATA_BREACH';

description: Raises the task to answer a personal-data access, correction, consent-withdrawal or restriction request.
name: Personal-data subject request

description: Raises the BPJS Ketenagakerjaan family-data change when marital status or dependants change.
name: BPJS Ketenagakerjaan family-data change

description: Raises the task to dispose of a leaver's personal data after the ten-year retention period.
name: Dispose of personal data after retention

description: Raises the pre-employment health examination task when no accepted examination is recorded within the previous three months.
name: Pre-employment health examination

references.title: Permenakertrans PER.02/MEN/1980, official Kemnaker-hosted text read 2026-10-10: https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/asset/data_puu/1980PermenakertransPER2MEN%20.pdf art.2(2), (7)

description: Raises the task to report a completed worker health examination to the labour office.
name: Worker health examination report

condition: return ctx.entry.kind === 'WORKER_HEALTH_EXAMINATION_COMPLETED';

name: Late wage: fine owed to the worker
